name: invoice-parser
description: Upload invoices and purchase orders, extract structured data, validate it, and review it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @invoice-parser/api" "npm run dev -w @invoice-parser/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @invoice-parser/shared && npm run typecheck -w @invoice-parser/api && npm run typecheck -w @invoice-parser/web
